scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n db,api,worker,web -c gray,blue,magenta,green "npm run db -w api" "npm run dev -w api" "npm run worker -w api" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.test: npm test -w api && npm test -w web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w api && npm run typecheck -w web
scripts.build: npm run build -w api && npm run build -w web
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n db,api,worker "npm run db -w api" "npm run start -w api" "npm run start:worker -w api"
scripts.dev:external-db: concurrently -k -n api,worker,web -c blue,magenta,green "npm run dev -w api" "npm run worker -w api" "npm run dev -w web"
